test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__Unless she doesn’t study__ French carefully, she cannot get the highest marks in the class.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****Unless she studies.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We use the conjunction **unless** to mean **‘except if’ **or** 'if not.'**
